gates.G0: PASS — the incumbent market-cap basis is already consistent; 1,618 of 1,638 cells identical to machine precision, all 20 differences the incumbent correctly restating shares across a split
gates.G1: INCREMENTAL_SURVIVES — ICC carries return information beyond B/P, size, momentum, FY1 yield and the forecast slope; coefficient 0.8198 at clustered t 7.482, VIF 2.1-3.1, but 40% below the R3 coefficient on the identical sample
gates.G2: PASS — permutation kills the spread at 5/5 origins for B/P and 4/5 for size; no leakage onto past returns; a shuffled-price placebo distribution centred at -0.14 with zero reps reaching the observed value
gates.G3: HORIZON_SPECIFIC — pooled positive at all three horizons and direction stable, but the 12-month clustered t is 1.634 against a frozen bound of 2. The 36-month t of 7.07 rests on windows overlapping two years each
gates.G4: DATA_INSUFFICIENT — REPLICATES was fixed unreachable before any result. 54.2% of the 36-month coefficient disappears when small-at-origin firms are removed, and removal bias is unobservable in this data

why_not_release_research_beta: mandate §17 requires G3 stable/consistent; G3 returned HORIZON_SPECIFIC
mandate §11 forbids public numeric release on a FAIL or INSUFFICIENT G4; G4 returned DATA_INSUFFICIENT
each blocks release independently — this is not one marginal miss but two separate conditions
why_not_retire_icc_lens: G1 found no collapse into the forecast strip, and identification is clean at VIF 2.1-3.1
G2 found no leakage and no placebo failure
direction is consistent at every horizon, every universe cut and both forecast paths
the failures are of precision and of data availability, not of the lens's direction

what_keep_internal_shadow_means_here.permitted: continued internal computation, the G5 append-only shadow archive, and internal research use of ICC, ICC-minus-risk-free and their internal history
what_keep_internal_shadow_means_here.forbidden: any public numeric surface, any published percentile, any price target, any republication of the retired heuristic band under a new name, and any feedback of a price-implied ICC into a same-date fair-value discount rate
what_keep_internal_shadow_means_here.public_surface_state: unchanged all mission — sustainable-index-ranges public projection holds rows=[] and fair-values.json holds display_ready=false with all six index rows at status NULL

honest_magnitude_statement.reading: Each stage of adversarial control removed roughly half of what remained. The direction survived every stage; the magnitude did not. And the one bias we could not measure — firms that left the index and are absent from the panel entirely — pushes in the same direction as the ones we could.

yoo_successor_bridge.structural_note: The GLS-ICC is solved from the current price. Using it as the discount rate in a same-date fair value reproduces the price from the price. A successor requires a cost of equity identified independently of the price being valued, and none exists in this repository.

binding_constraint: Five annual origins with overlapping 36-month windows, on a universe defined by August 2026 index membership. The constraint is the data, not the model. It improves with elapsed time and with point-in-time record keeping started now — which is what G5 and BACKLOG #380 are for.
